name: Underground Map
summary: Near Ironband's Compound, the Underground Map points toward chambers beneath Ironforge. Recovered from Dark Iron spies, its runes trace a hidden route piercing toward ancient halls beneath the mountain. You bring it to Earthseer Farsen to begin learning what lies below.

sections.title: A Blueprint of Infiltration
sections.body: You find the parchment near Ironband's Compound after dealing with Dark Iron spies. Its diagrams lay out an intricate maze of roads beneath the earth. Harsh, jagged runes mark passages that run deep underground and converge beneath Ironforge. Their course suggests a possible threat beneath the Bronzebeard capital, though the Dark Iron notes remain uncertain.

sections.title: Whispers on the Wind
sections.body: As you study the crude map, an unnatural gust carries the faint murmur of a dwarf's voice. It urges swift action and points you to Earthseer Farsen. You take this warning to him, where it may expose early movements toward ancient halls sealed deep below the city and threaten the mountain kingdom's sanctuary.

faq.q: Where did this underground map come from?
faq.answer: Dark Iron spies carried the map while surveying the perimeter of Ironband's Compound in Dun Morogh. You find it among their scouts in the foothills.
The map shows a complex network of underground highways and tunnels snaking through the earth. They converge beneath Ironforge.

Earthseer Farsen is a dwarven earthseer from Aerie Peak, attuned to the deep rocks and mountain spirits. He senses unnatural movements below ground and needs the map to assess the breach beneath Ironforge.

faq.q: Why are the Dark Irons tunneling under Ironforge?
faq.answer: The map suggests a possible route beneath Ironforge, but its Dark Iron notes remain undeciphered. Earthseer Farsen must examine it before their plan can be established.

faq.q: What does this quest lead to?
faq.answer: Bringing the map to Earthseer Farsen begins an effort to investigate the depths beneath the city. It leads into the Old Ironforge Incursion and opens a way toward the Hall of Thanes.

faq.q: What language are the map's runes written in?
faq.answer: The map bears the jagged runic script of the Dark Iron dwarves. Whoever finds it cannot be sure what the notes say.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard dwarf, you know Dark Iron tunnels running straight toward Ironforge's foundation are a grave breach of the capital's borders.
As a shaman, you may hear the gust guiding you to Earthseer Farsen as a warning from elemental spirits. They sense unnatural digging beneath Dun Morogh.
As an Alliance member, you know this underground route must be stopped to keep Ironforge and the Alliance's northern anchor secure.
